entities.name: UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to establish a PDU session, including emergency sessions and handovers between access types.

entities.name: Timer T3580
entities.description: Timer used during PDU session establishment procedure. Expiry triggers retransmission or procedure abortion.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: 5GSM message sent by UE to initiate PDU session establishment procedure.

entities.name: Request type
entities.description: IE indicating type of PDU session request (initial emergency, existing emergency, existing PDU session, etc.).

entities.name: PDU session ID
entities.description: Identifier for the PDU session used in various 5GSM messages.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered when PDU session establishment procedure is aborted.

entities.name: Emergency request type condition
entities.description: Condition where request type is set to initial emergency request or existing emergency PDU session.

entities.name: Fifth T3580 expiry condition
entities.description: Condition when timer T3580 expires for the fifth time during PDU session establishment.

entities.name: Procedure abortion
entities.description: Behavior where UE aborts the PDU session establishment procedure and releases resources.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND
entities.description: Network-initiated message to release a PDU session.

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network to release a PDU session.

relations.description: PDU session establishment procedure starts timer T3580.
Procedure includes sending PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.
Message contains PDU session ID IE.
Emergency request type condition may lead to procedure abortion.
Fifth T3580 expiry condition leads to procedure abortion.
Procedure abortion results in entering PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message is part of network-requested PDU session release procedure.
Message contains PDU session ID IE.
